title: 同相加法器（弥尔曼定理）
statement: 图示电路中 v_1 = 1 V，v_2 = 4 V，R_1 = 10 kΩ，R_2 = 20 kΩ，R_g = 10 kΩ，R_f = 20 kΩ，op-amp（运算放大器）为理想 op-amp。
求同相端电位 v_p、R_1 中的电流 i_1（参考方向见图）和输出电压 v_o。

questions.explain: 虚短 v_n = v_p = 2 V，同相放大：v_o = (1 + R_f/R_g)·v_p = 3 × 2 = 6 V。

hints: 同相端不取电流，所以结点 p 只接 R_1、R_2 两条支路：用弥尔曼定理（结点电压法）求 v_p。
求出 v_p 后，右半部分就是一个同相比例放大器。
solution: **3. 同相放大：** R_f 把输出接回反相端，构成负反馈，由虚短 v_n = v_p = 2 V。R_g 电流 2/10k = 0.2 mA，由虚断全部来自 R_f：v_o = 2 + 20k × 0.2 mA = **6 V** = (1 + R_f/R_g)·v_p。

en.title: Non-inverting summer (Millman's theorem)
statement: In the circuit v_1 = 1 V, v_2 = 4 V, R_1 = 10 kΩ, R_2 = 20 kΩ, R_g = 10 kΩ, R_f = 20 kΩ; the op-amp is ideal.
Find the potential v_p of the non-inverting input, the current i_1 in R_1 (reference as drawn) and the output voltage v_o.

questions.explain: Virtual open: node p only connects R_1 and R_2. Millman's theorem: v_p = (v_1/R_1 + v_2/R_2)/(1/R_1 + 1/R_2) = (0.1 + 0.2)/0.15 = 2 V (currents in mA, conductances in mS).
i_1 = (v_1 − v_p)/R_1 = (1 − 2)/10k = −0.1 mA. R_2 carries (4 − 2)/20k = 0.1 mA from v_2 to p, which then flows through R_1 into v_1 — the non-inverting input takes none of it.
Virtual short v_n = v_p = 2 V, non-inverting gain: v_o = (1 + R_f/R_g)·v_p = 3 × 2 = 6 V.

hints: The non-inverting input draws no current, so node p connects only the two branches R_1 and R_2: use Millman's theorem (nodal analysis) for v_p.
Once v_p is known, the right half is simply a non-inverting amplifier.
solution: **2. Current in R_1:** i_1 = (1 − 2)/10 kΩ = **−0.1 mA**; R_2 carries (4 − 2)/20 kΩ = 0.1 mA, and the two balance at p.

**3. Non-inverting stage:** R_f connects the output back to the inverting input (negative feedback), so by the virtual short v_n = v_p = 2 V. R_g carries 2/10k = 0.2 mA, all of it from R_f (virtual open): v_o = 2 + 20k × 0.2 mA = **6 V** = (1 + R_f/R_g)·v_p.
